# gosysml2: LLM/Agent Context

## Project Purpose
`gosysml2` is a Go library that parses SysML v2 and KerML textual models.
It exposes:
- low-level parser access in `low` (ANTLR-oriented)
- high-level typed semantic model in `sysml`

## Current Version
`v0.4.0` (source of truth: `VERSION`).

## Canonical Entry Points
- High-level parsing:
  - `sysml.ParseString`, `sysml.ParseFile`, `sysml.ParseBytes`, `sysml.ParseReader`
  - `sysml.ParseStringContext`, `sysml.ParseFileContext`, `sysml.ParseBytesContext`, `sysml.ParseReaderContext`
  - `sysml.ParseDir`
  - `sysml.ParseStringModel`, `sysml.ParseFileModel`
- Low-level parsing:
  - `low.Parse`, `low.ParseBytes`, `low.ParseWithContext`
  - `low.Validate`, `low.ValidateBytes`

## Model and Query API (High-Level)
- Root: `*sysml.Model`
- Common element types: `Package`, `Part`, `Item`, `Attribute`, `Requirement`, `Verification`, `Action`, `State`, `Flow`, `Import`, `Alias`, `Metadata`
- Query/traversal:
  - `sysml.FindAll[T]`
  - `sysml.Filter`, `sysml.FindByQualifiedName`, `sysml.FindByKind`, `sysml.FindByName`
  - `sysml.Walk`, `sysml.Visit`, `sysml.All`, `sysml.OfType`, `sysml.OfKind`

## Reference Semantics
- References are `Ref[T]` and may be unresolved.
- Use `IsResolved()`, `Resolved()`, `Name()`, `EffectiveName()`.
- Name model semantics:
  - `Name()` = declared name
  - `DeclaredShortName()` = short-name form `<...>` when present

## Parse Result Contract
High-level parse returns `*sysml.ParseResult`:
- `Model *Model`
- `ParseError *ParseError`
- `Tree antlr.Tree` (optional; can be dropped)
- `Source string`
- `Hash string`
- `Rewrites []string`
- `Err() error`
- `Errors() []*Error`

## Options
- `sysml.WithDiscardTree()`
- `sysml.WithSource(source)`
- `sysml.WithoutCompatibilityRewrites()`
- `sysml.WithStandardLibrary()`
- `sysml.WithLibraryPath(path)`
- `sysml.WithLibraryRegistry(reg)`
- `low.WithParseTree(bool)`
- `low.WithContext(ctx)`

## Agent Guidance
- Prefer `sysml` API for user-facing integrations.
- Use `low` only when ANTLR/tree-level behavior is explicitly needed.
- Treat `VERSION` as the source of truth for release version.
